decisionGate.question: The submitted authority requires a new closed public refusal contract but does not supply the referenced sealed owner direction that fixes the exact blocker enum or the v0.1 leaf migration. Which smallest public Fixer contract does the owner seal?
options: Split hard cut: keep classesRepaired for completed classes, require per-class commitSha there, add nonempty classesRemaining{name,remainingScope} on refused, remove top-level Fixer commitSha/prose-only refusal, and close blocker.category to authority_conflict | missing_required_input | unsafe_repository_state | false_or_stale_premise.

Unified hard cut: replace classesRepaired/top-level Fixer commitSha with classResults entries discriminated as completed or remaining, require a remaining entry on refused, and use the same four-category blocker union.
Supply the omitted sealed owner direction if its enum or compatibility choice differs; construction will follow those exact public-contract bytes rather than inventing a third design.

details.note: Explicit disposition of all submitted requirements: (1) the professional law is settled—unfinished authorized safe plan/apply work is not inability and Fixer continues; (2) its irreducible Soul material is one persistence sentence, but CLAUDE.md §修订通道 reserves the actual Soul edit to owner direct review; (3) typed refusal and failure-channel separation are construction-ready except for the exact public enum in this gate; (4) multi-class packets and exact per-class completed/exception/remaining accounting are fixed, with no cardinality-based one-class rule; (5) partial forward commits remain completed class evidence and never become a refusal ground; (6) production activation/submission tests must reject the submitted pseudo-blockers, accept the sealed legitimate blockers, and prove infrastructure failure cannot issue refused; (7) README, exports, shared terminating validator, Recorder projection, generated dist and packed artifacts must migrate consistently, while historical docket JSON is not rewritten—the old-leaf acceptance choice is the gate; (8) packet composition, compatibility grouping, invocation budget, stopping, sequencing and dispatch remain caller-owned, and no scheduler/orchestrator is authorized. No Plan is requested. The current seam facts independently checked at head 9247ab8 are that worker-output accepts prose-only refused, classesRepaired is completed-only and lacks per-class commit/remaining scope, Recorder delegates to that shared validator, and package version is 0.1.0. Adding only Soul prose cannot satisfy fail-closed typed refusal; adding a second guard outside the shared leaf would be a parallel mechanism.
